notes:
One setup screen for every service, and a defect found by the tests that made it possible.

MANAGE STATIONS replaces the old two-step flow. Selecting a service now presents its content directly — one list with what is already in your library sorted to the top, then everything else alphabetically or by popularity. Tap adds or removes immediately; there is no Save button. Search throughout, and genre filters for iHeart, whose catalogue is the only one too large to show whole.

THE SCREEN IS WRITTEN ONCE. iHeartRADIO, SomaFM, SiriusXM, Sonos Radio and Spotify each supply a small adapter rather than a screen of their own, so the next service costs an adapter and nothing else.

A DEFECT FOUND BY UNIT TESTS, not by use: reading favorites returned an empty list when a speaker REFUSED, which is indistinguishable from a household that has saved nothing. With no Sonos reachable the app would have advised saving favorites the user already had. It now reports the two states separately.

NOT IN THIS RELEASE: the favorites-backed services are wired to the new screen but were verified only for iHeart and SomaFM — the others need a Sonos system on the network.
